children: , the world's leading manufacturer of advanced AI chips, posted record August revenue of NT$514.8 billion, or approximately $16.3 billion. Sales surged 53% year over year, yet the American depositary receipts slipped approximately 1.1% to $430.99 Thursday morning.

The numbers are hard to dismiss. TSMC generated roughly NT$1.27 trillion in second-quarter revenue with a 67.7% gross margin, meaning August alone equaled about 40.5% of the previous quarter's sales. A single month does not guarantee another blockbuster quarter, but it hardly points to an AI-chip slowdown.

The selloff looks more like an expectations reset than a demand warning. The chart shows TSMC trading 30.77% above its GF Value estimate of $329.58, highlighting how much future growth investors already expect. Record sales support the AI demand story, but rising yields, massive capital requirements and a rich valuation leave little room for execution to cool.

title: TSMC Falls After Record Sales--AI Investors Want Even More
